notes: Tests the v2 engine against the shared playbook. The Big Leap case is the universality gate (must OMIT the mechanism, not force one). Replace the synthetic Big Leap inputs with real data when available.

cases.case_study: Supergut — $100k/mo paused Meta -> $1m/mo new-customer revenue in 3 months
cases.literal_mechanism: Seeded ~1,200 unpaid micro-creators and ran their content as the paid creative on Meta

expect.mechanism: GENERATE (mechanism carries — DTC seeding is distinctive)
expect.must_include: connector-led lines ("using…"/"mostly by…"); a picture not a label (e.g. 'gifting/seeding 1,200 creators and running ads off their posts' over 'viral micro creator seeding strategy')
must_not_include: the bare fragment with no connector
expect.native_unit: new-customer revenue / the creator count — a founder's counting unit

cases.case_study: [Big Leap client] — added $X in organic pipeline in N months via Google/GEO ranking (SYNTHETIC placeholder modeled on W9 Velox/Dr Axe until real data lands)
cases.literal_mechanism: Ranked them #1 on Google/AI search for high-intent keywords
top_pains: tried agencies that didn't move organic

expect.mechanism: OMIT — the 'mechanism' just restates the result (ranking). This is the universality gate.
expect.must_include: an explicit 'lead on result + specificity' return; a 'without paid ads / without burning CAC' wrapper line; the {keyword}/niche specificity
expect.fail_condition: inventing a fake distinctive mechanism instead of omitting — this is exactly the v1 Big Leap failure

expect.mechanism: GENERATE or OMIT depending on case strength — check what the closest winner did
expect.must_include: connector-led, picture-over-label, native unit for the persona
expect.note: Second offer to prove the engine isn't Kynship-shaped

cases.literal_mechanism: Worked closely with the brand on their marketing

expect.must_return: a request for the specific tactic/channel/named approach — must NOT invent a mechanism
expect.fail_condition: producing any mechanism line from this empty input

pass_threshold: 3 of 4 (the kickback case counts as pass when it correctly refuses). The Big Leap OMIT case is a must-pass — it's the whole universality point.
